citations.claim: Mac revenue was $8 billion, up 15% year over year, driven by continued strength across the portfolio, including MacBook Air, Mac Mini, and MacBook Pro.
citations.source_text: Mac revenue was $8 billion, up 15% year over year, driven by continued strength across the portfolio, including MacBook Air, Mac Mini, and MacBook Pro.

citations.claim: Apple reported June-quarter revenue of $94 billion, up 10% year over year and a June-quarter record.
citations.source_text: Our revenue of $94 billion was up 10% year over year and is a new June quarter record.

citations.claim: iPad revenue was $6.6 billion, down 8% year over year, which was expected given the difficult compare against the launch of the iPad Air and iPad Pro in the year ago quarter.
citations.source_text: iPad revenue was $6.6 billion, down 8% year over year, which was expected given the difficult compare against the launch of the iPad Air and iPad Pro in the year ago quarter.

citations.claim: Wearables, Home and Accessories revenue was $7.4 billion, down 9% year over year.
citations.source_text: Wearables home and accessories revenue was $7.4 billion, down 9% year over year.

citations.claim: Apple reported June-quarter records for net income of $23.4 billion and diluted earnings per share of $1.57; diluted EPS was up 12% year over year.
citations.source_text: This strong business performance led to June quarter records for both net income at $23.4 billion and diluted earnings per share of $1.57, which was up 12% year over year.
